plans.objective: [DIM: optimization] The apparent flatness of N_c(w) for rigid families is an optimization artifact: small networks get stuck in local minima, falsely indicating rigidity when they simply fail to converge to the true solution.

steps.description: Implement the `family` function to define rigid (linear) and fat (quadratic) constraint families for the capacity scan experiment. This addresses the core scientific question of whether network capacity trends reflect solution space rigidity. The code must construct training/holdout points as (N,1) arrays, ensure non-overlapping holdout sets, and return the required dictionary format. The capacity_scan pipeline (already built in the sandbox) will handle the L-BFGS-B optimization, multi-start sampling, and N_c(w) computation.
